cvd_tube.status: Tier 1. MoO3 vapour pressure from Smolik et al. 2000 (solid branch; an optional liquid branch above 1068 K, psat_model smolik_liquid_cc, is a Clausius-Clapeyron continuation pinned to 1 atm at 1428 K from a secondary page quoting CRC, with synthetic-grade uncertainty; the default is unchanged). Shape map: hypothesis. Edge rates are synthetic; DFT Mo-edge S binding (Rosen et al. 2018) is an option and the map is still not predictive (shape accuracy 0.50 = always-triangle baseline, n = 14, 8 in scope). Sensitivity direction (pre-registered, Track A): original 8 items model 2/8 vs blind no-tool baseline 6/8 vs always-increase 4/8; held-out j1-j3 (one paper) 0/3, no claim; handles added for MoO3/S inventory and source-substrate gap. Tier 0 regime call re-derived with a wall-uptake driving-force term; agrees with the CFD convention on 37/40 sweep cases (was 26/40); the CFD label is an agent-chosen convention (63 % uptake), not measured. Mesh: tube GCI 0.8-13 %, mostly oscillatory (target 2 % missed). Surrogate: multi-fidelity correction does not reach 5 % (LOO median error 24-36 %); tube outputs span 3.5-6.6 decades of CFD/Tier 1 and are not learnable from 40 cases. Substrate flux is insensitive to boat temperature when the substrate is more than about 4 cm from the boat (wall uptake NTU about 11 at the default geometry): intended transport physics, not a bug, and the stored CFD saturates the same way (Track K). Rescored with each paper's own stated geometry (Track L), the sensitivity result is 1/9 strict against a blind agent's 6/9 (all items are development data; no held-out set exists); some papers use a cooler substrate than the source and the model has no stated value for that offset. A sourced equilibrium edge model from Momeni et al. SI and Cao et al. 2015 (VASP PBE) reproduces Cao's printed shape sequence but does not beat always-triangle on the shape benchmark and does not reproduce Momeni's hexagon-to-triangle trend along the substrate. Optional reactive substrate sink and four wall-uptake variants (Track M; proposed, not validated, all new constants synthetic): the reactive sink removes the exact-zero flux for a hot substrate but does not restore the boat-temperature response far from the boat; that response returns only with a reflecting wall, so the wall-uptake assumption controls the result and the CFD (similar wall law) cannot test it. Structural-ensemble sensitivity calls: 1/9 strict, mostly unresolved; no improvement over a blind agent (6/9). Furnace and flow physics (Track N, optional thermal_model=furnace): editable 1-3 zone or measured furnace profile, quartz radial network, 2D gas energy equation, computed boat and substrate temperatures. Agrees with the stored same-physics CFD on 45 of 52 cases (legacy 35); did not reproduce Momeni 2018's simulated gas peak (+143 K); no measured temperature validates the absolute boat or substrate temperature; quartz and boat properties are synthetic.

ampoule.status: Tier 1. Thermochemistry sourced for WO2 + HgX2 presets, but the model over-predicts published transport rates by about 1x to 38x (not tuned). Convection enhancement is CFD-calibrated (laminar, square duct for tilts) and flagged outside the scanned range. 60-case CFD sweep: Tier 0 agreement 81.7 % (threshold 1.1) / 75 % (1.2) with the CFD f>1.1 / f>1.2 convention; the stratification fix adds nothing over no stratification term when scored held-out (tier2/verification/b3_results.json). Finest mesh done: GCI 0.0-2.1 % on 3 steady cases, 13 % (unsteady, not meaningful) on the strong-convection case. Surrogate: correction does not reach 5 % (LOO median error 27-31 %), and adds essentially nothing over Tier 1. A possible sign error in Tier 1's composition-buoyancy term is unchecked. OpenFOAM matches Tier 1 within 2 % for diffusion-limited cases.

flask.status: Tier 1. Villermaux-Dushman model checked against secondary papers; the stir-bar power number is a placeholder. Tier 2 reachable via tier2.openfoam.write_case('flask', ...). Np_torque closure is a single-point value (docs/flask_closure_np.json): CFD Np 0.956 (band 0.82-1.09) at Re 4636 and 0.856 (0.81-0.90) at Re 9271 vs Tier 1 about 0.51, i.e. Tier 1 is about 1.7-1.9x low; mesh GCI 5-14 % (non-monotone, flagged), frozen rotor, wall functions; not wired into Tier 1. No published stir-bar Np(Re) was found. OpenFOAM only.

sorbent.status: Tier 1. CO2/N2/H2O isotherms sourced from two Alberta theses (13X, CALF-20). CALF-20 breakthrough within 3-10 %. 13X breakthrough still 38-39 % early with the thesis wall coefficient; a single effective h_in fitted on one peak temperature reduces this to 10-16 % on a held-out flow but is not adopted (missed the pre-registered 15 % threshold by 0.6 points). CO2/H2O competition: extended Langmuir under-predicts CO2 by 17 % and 41 %; IAST is worse (CO2 about 0, water +18 to +36 %), so it is not used. Heat-transfer coefficients synthetic.

photoreactor.status: Tier 1. Optical chain (wall transmission, Beer-Lambert, quantum yield x absorbed photons) compared with two published ferrioxalate actinometry setups (Saenz 2024; phi from Hatchard & Parker 1956): predicted/measured = 0.88 (collimated) and 0.69 (diffuse), both inside the pre-registered tolerances. One paper, one lab. Lamp power -> irradiance, mixing cap (unsourced heuristic) and temperature rise (upper bound) are NOT validated.
